notes.title: Update on Tlatoani release window
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

We have some updates on the development progress of Tlatoani! [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
First of all, we’re progressing steadily towards our 1.0 goals! We’re currently aiming for the 1.0 release of Tlatoani to include:[/p][list][*][p]At least 20 historic missions, divided into 3 chapters.[/p][/*][*][p]At least 6 Monument buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Remaining animations[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to UI and tutorial experience[/p][/*][*][p]Additional voiceover and SFX [/p][/*][*][p]Map editor to help with custom map design[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234895/11832b9c131281a9171616b5e3dbe56a7e5fc533.png"][/img][i]A look at in-development custom scenario editor
[/i][/p][h3]What is next?[/h3][p]In the past few months we’ve made good progress with all these features, and are on track to meet the goals we set out to achieve during our Early Access. At this point, we want to ask you for a bit more patience. To make sure Tlatoani is the game we promised you, and an adventure in the Aztec civilization that we can be proud of, we’ll need a little more time.[/p][p]
For that reason we’re moving the release window for Tlatoani 1.0 to [b]Q1 2026[/b]. We’ll keep sharing updates as the development progresses, and we hope you’ll keep sharing your feedback and impressions as we go along!

Thank you for your continuous support so far![/p]

notes.title: Prologue Ending
notes.content:
Dear Tlatoani players,

We have some important news to share. The Tlatoani Prologue will be taken down on December 19th. This marks the end of its journey as we prepare for the next chapter in Tlatoani’s development.

Once again we want to thank everyone who played for their feedback and support during the development process.  And we do have one last update to make- the current build of the Prologue should now allow you to export saves as scenario-files for loading in the main game.

In order to do this:
[olist][*] Go to Settings -> Simulation in the Prologue, and Check 'Save City as XML'.
[expand type=details expanded=false][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44976072/118a1cefa828f3af10eed2b45f3e9cf641c0e335.png[/img][/expand]
[*] Open one of your cities in-game and then save it again- this will generate a .scen.xml copy of your .tlt file in the saves directory.  (Note: you can right-click on your games in the steam library to browse local files!)
[expand type=details expanded=false][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44976072/57a99497d06e1fef3b2b962402e4e4e4e77e47cb.png[/img][/expand]
[*] Move or copy this file to the media/Scenarios/General folder of the main game- your prologue city should now be available to play in the main game as a freestyle scenario.
[expand type=details expanded=false][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44976072/67a0e671b5d9f05cf00d61e1d8a3c58ceaa49d68.png[/img][/expand][/olist]

We will also be adding a free demo to the main game for players to try.  While the demo will feature less content than the Prologue, it will still give new players a glimpse into the core experience of Tlatoani.  It’s a perfect way to try out the game or introduce it to a friend.

If you have any trouble with city-save exports, let us know on the forums or official discord.  Jump into the Prologue now before it’s gone!

Play the Prologue: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925280/Tlatoani_Aztec_Cities_Prologue/

[url=https://discord.gg/2bGGBrmB][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44976072/9e4eb86d69277c3db4e32b05eefc0771cc21ceda.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Roadmap Update and Future Plans
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Since the Early Access launch, we’ve been collecting and collating your feedback, and have been grateful for your detailed - and often passionate - responses, which have been invaluable. Based on this feedback, we've drawn up some plans for the coming weeks, stretching into the new year.

[h2]What's Coming Next[/h2]
[list]
[*]We're adding more detailed and complex tooltips to provide reminders of common game functions and make it easier to pick up mechanics as you go.
[*]We're planning some balance adjustments to the early history campaign to ease in the player more gently, although moving into V1 we may be offloading some of the tutorial steps to the learner scenarios instead.
[*]Time allowing, we aim to add the Tizaapan and Cuauhmixtitlan missions to cap off the first chapter of the history campaign before Christmas, at least on the testing branch.
[*]We’re laying the groundwork for broader localization efforts in the new year.
[*]Finally, an in-game help encyclopedia is planned, although this will be a long-term project.
[/list]

Here’s a sneak peek at some of the upcoming tooltips- let us know what you think!

notes.title: Interface and settings: tips for the game
notes.content:
We're currently hard at work on fixes and various improvements, though we're not quite ready to share the details just yet. But there is another area which we want to highlight today - different Quality of Life features and overall settings! Those options might help you to speed up the game (even more), access advisors faster, or change vibrancy of the game.

And if you need any help, want to give us feedback or just talk to the devs - join our Discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/NvRV8YQnm5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234895/9e4eb86d69277c3db4e32b05eefc0771cc21ceda.png[/img][/url]


[h3]Change Fast Forward Multiplayer[/h3]
Increase speed by right-clicking the speed button and choosing a suitable option.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234895/c4b33c02fa1e360f3eb83b153f975b92d64194b7.png[/img] 

[h3]Pin Advisor Windows[/h3]
Press pin button to pin any of the advisor windows to the top bar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234895/619e07145d28d76a42bb97f1e339ca6b534f0cdf.png[/img]

[h3]Game Graphics Vibrancy[/h3]
Adjust the game GFX vibrancy levels by pressing Esc and clicking on User Settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234895/fc160333c5d403c9e04e6ca624e6b72baa9e511f.png[/img]

[h3]God Mode[/h3]
Toggle God Mode on/off in the settings menu at any time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234895/655ce564cbc245a43592eec42dbe9cd63a5ba38e.png[/img]

[h3]Day and Weather Effects[/h3]
Toggle Weather and Day/Night Cycle on/off by pressing Esc, clicking on User Settings, and then clicking on Simulation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234895/f25a15a4e655c9bb38ac3e06a918ab921e75f601.png[/img]

[h3]Hide Map[/h3]
Hide mini-map by pressing button in the bottom-left.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234895/51ac06e7dce10f94c242a083df29d7ba5947ef14.png[/img]

[h3]Hide UI[/h3]
And last but not least - hide the entire UI by pressing the “\” (backslash) button on your keyboard (if you  are using US layout - otherwise check hotkeys in settings).

That’s all for today! We hope these tips help you tailor the game to your liking. Enjoy!

notes.title: Roadmap and Future Plans
notes.content:
Today, we want to share a roadmap for Tlatoani post-Early Access launch. These plans are flexible and open to change - [b]we’re committed to incorporating player feedback and prioritise community concerns over what is in the current iteration of the Roadmap[/b]. With that in mind, here’s a look at it…

[h2]EA improvements[/h2]
Let’s start with what you can expect from Early Access:
[list][*] We’ve revamped the tutorial and integrated it into the campaign. Legacy tutorial is still available in the scenarios sections.
[*] Some of the citizen’s animations are now in place to add life to your city. We will be adding more as development continues.
[*] You’ll also find new content, including a couple of new buildings, including monuments, and several new scenarios to explore. 
[*] And last but not least, we will add a random map generator for even more varied gameplay experiences.[/list]

[h2]Localization & Modding Support[/h2]
Making Tlatoani accessible and customizable. We’re moving all definitions for buildings, citizens, terrain types, and cities to external .xml files, including English UI text, for easier editing and translation. 

[h2]More Chapters for Historical Campaign[/h2]
We’re on our way to expanding the Historical Campaign:
[list][*] Chapter 1: Founding of Tenochtitlan
 Experience the beginning of Tenochtitlan’s history with 10-12 missions and monument projects, including the early Templo Mayor. Currently, only the Tizaapan and Cuauhmixtitlan missions remain unfinished.
[*] Chapter 2: Rise of the Triple Alliance
Covering the Tepanec-Mexica conquest of the Anahuac Valley and the Mexica/Acolhua revolt, this chapter includes 6-8 missions and additional new monuments. 
[*] Chapter 3: Rise of the Aztec Empire
This chapter will explore expansion outside the valley, conflicts with the Purepecha and Tlaxcalans, and the seeds of future discontent. Featuring 8-10 missions and additional monument projects.[/list]

[h2]Map & Scenario Editor[/h2]
Map and scenario editor will add customization options for maps and events. Features will include a terrain editor, event triggers like invasions or gifts, and export options.

[h2]Extra Random Map Options[/h2]
We plan to expand landform and climate options to add more variety to sandbox gameplay. Future options could include islands, peninsulas, and unique climates like maritime and deep desert environments. 

[h2]Expanded Gameplay[/h2]
[list][*] We have plans to expand gameplay options further, but they are low priority right now:
[*] Noble VIPs – option to assign noble VIPs to venues to gain production and service bonuses.
[*] Ruler events – ‘roleplay’ choices, including ‘technological advancements’.
[*] Expanded military units – with possible new units such as archers, jaguar knights, and war priests.
[*] Intrigue and diplomacy – systems for marriages, espionage, and unique gifts.[/list]

[h2]Visual & Audio Enhancements[/h2]
To bring Tlatoani’s world to life, we’re enhancing both visuals and sound:
Building and Citizen Sprites – new citizen sprites are on the way and will increment gradually over time, and building sprite updates will be done over the coming months (but they will take some time). 
Music & Sound Effects – Additional sound effects and custom music pieces for missions are planned to deepen the immersion.


That covers our current plans. Keep in mind, that this plan is flexible and there will likely be some changes made along the line, depending on the player feedback. If it comes to that, we’ll communicate any changes in the roadmap and priorities, as they happen.

notes.title: Tlatoani: Aztec Cities is Now Available in Early Access!
notes.content:
Are you ready to experience the rise of the Aztec civilization, city by city? Tlatoani invites you to lead, govern, and shape an empire set in the heart of Mesoamerica.

As Tlatoani, you’ll oversee everything - from aligning buildings in perfect harmony to managing resources, diplomacy, and sacred rites. Every decision shapes your legacy. Available now in Early Access - begin your journey to the throne!

[h2]Early Access Key Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Explore Aztec culture and society. The game immerses you in Aztec history and culture, from primary food sources to religious festivals.
[*] Become Tlatoani and build an empire. Play a campaign filled with historical challenges. Take your first steps as Tlatoani, learning to build cities, forge alliances, and create an empire that will stand the test of time.
[*] Two ways to learn the basics of the game - through campaign or legacy tutorial in the scenarios sections.
[*] Solve six unique scenarios. Play six distinct scenarios with varied objectives. Find the best strategies to achieve goals and expand the city.
[*] Overcome challenges with the random map generator. Each new map presents a unique puzzle, featuring diverse landscapes that bring the environments of Mesoamerica to life.
[*] Meet the needs of your citizens. Each citizen is individually simulated, with their skills, needs, duties, beliefs, moods, and routines.
[/list]

Take the first step on your path to building an empire in the heart of Mesoamerica! Get Tlatoani: Aztec Cities now.
